nodes.name: generate-h3-corpus.ts
nodes.summary: Benchmark script that drives an LLM oracle (Opus) to generate H3 corpus instances for the GEPA faza-1 benchmark, writing JSONL output with resumability and spot-audit reporting.

nodes.name: callOpusOracle
nodes.summary: Calls the Anthropic API (Opus model) with retry-and-backoff logic to generate corpus instance JSON from a prompt.

nodes.name: generateOneCell
nodes.summary: Orchestrates generation of one stratification cell: calls oracle, parses JSON, assembles and validates the instance.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point: parses args, resumes from existing JSONL, iterates through all corpus cells and generates instances, writes output stream.

nodes.name: probe-registry-injection.ts
nodes.summary: Diagnostic script that probes prompt-shape registry injection behavior, exercising the shape selector to verify registration side effects.

nodes.name: run-checkpoint-c.ts
nodes.summary: GEPA Checkpoint-C evaluation harness: loads corpus instances, evaluates candidate prompt shapes via trio judge scoring, and generates an in-sample vs held-out comparison report.

nodes.name: runOneEval
nodes.summary: Runs a single evaluation: creates a memory session, ingests materials, runs the retrieval agent loop with a candidate shape, and scores with trio judges.

nodes.name: buildCheckpointCSummary
nodes.summary: Builds a comprehensive Checkpoint-C summary report comparing in-sample and held-out fitness scores per candidate, including overfitting gap analysis.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point for the Checkpoint-C run: loads corpus, candidates, streams eval results to JSONL, and writes the final summary JSON.

nodes.name: run-gen-1.ts
nodes.summary: GEPA Generation-1 benchmark harness: evaluates candidate prompt shapes across corpus instances with mid-run halt detection and produces a Checkpoint-B summary report.

nodes.name: runOneEval
nodes.summary: Runs a single evaluation instance for one candidate shape, ingesting memory, running the retrieval agent, and scoring with trio judges.

nodes.name: checkMidRunHalts
nodes.summary: Inspects per-candidate accumulators mid-run to detect statistical dominance or futility conditions and returns a halt reason when early termination is warranted.

nodes.name: buildCheckpointBSummary
nodes.summary: Builds the Checkpoint-B markdown/JSON summary comparing all candidates by pass-rate, fitness, cost, and retrieval efficiency.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point: streams corpus evals across candidates with resumability, invokes mid-run halt checks, and writes final Checkpoint-B output.

nodes.name: run-mutation-oracle.ts
nodes.summary: GEPA mutation oracle script that uses an LLM (Opus) to propose mutations to a baseline prompt shape, assembles the TypeScript file, validates it, and writes candidate shape files.

nodes.name: buildOraclePrompt
nodes.summary: Constructs the oracle prompt that instructs the LLM to propose prompt-shape mutations, embedding baseline content and mutation guidelines.

nodes.name: buildShapeFile
nodes.summary: Assembles a TypeScript prompt-shape module file from parsed oracle output, inserting the LLM-proposed content into the correct scaffold.

nodes.name: run-null-baseline.ts
nodes.summary: Establishes a null/naive baseline evaluation against the GEPA corpus by running multiple prompt shapes without memory retrieval and scoring with trio judges.

nodes.name: runOneEval
nodes.summary: Runs one null-baseline evaluation: calls the LLM with the prompt shape directly (no retrieval), then scores the response with trio judges.

nodes.name: acceptance.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the GEPA candidate acceptance gate, evaluating whether a new prompt-shape candidate merits advancement based on fitness thresholds and performance deltas.

nodes.name: evaluateCandidate
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether a candidate prompt shape passes acceptance criteria relative to the incumbent, checking fitness thresholds and improvement deltas.

nodes.name: corpus-prompt.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the LLM prompt used to generate individual GEPA corpus instances from a stratification cell definition.

nodes.name: buildCorpusInstancePrompt
nodes.summary: Assembles the detailed instruction prompt for the oracle LLM to produce a structured corpus instance JSON for a given stratification cell.

nodes.name: corpus.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the GEPA faza-1 corpus: stratification cell schema, instance validation logic, deterministic sampling, spot-audit utilities, and corpus SHA-256 fingerprinting.

nodes.name: validateInstance
nodes.summary: Validates a corpus instance against required fields and constraints, returning a list of constraint violations.

nodes.name: runSpotAudit
nodes.summary: Runs a spot audit over a sample of corpus instances, re-validating each and returning pass/fail results per instance.

nodes.name: fitness.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the GEPA fitness scoring functions including tiered fitness, retrieval engagement bonus, cost penalty, and delta-floor verdict for prompt shape candidates.

nodes.name: computeTieredFitness
nodes.summary: Computes the full tiered fitness score for a candidate by combining pass rate, retrieval engagement bonus, and cost penalty across two tiers.

nodes.name: computeDeltaFloorVerdict
nodes.summary: Computes a statistical delta-floor verdict comparing a candidate to the incumbent by binomial confidence interval analysis.

nodes.name: mutation-oracle-fork.ts
nodes.summary: Provides utilities for the GEPA mutation oracle fork: shape classification, template path resolution, template loading, and oracle prompt construction.

nodes.name: mutation-validator.ts
nodes.summary: Validates mutated prompt-shape candidate files by checking SHA-256 integrity, structural constraints, and that the MULTI_STEP_ACTION_CONTRACT bytes are preserved unchanged.

nodes.name: validateCandidate
nodes.summary: Validates a mutation candidate file: checks file existence, structural shape, and byte-level integrity of the immutable MULTI_STEP_ACTION_CONTRACT section.

nodes.name: selection.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the GEPA candidate selection algorithm: ranks evaluated candidates by fitness, applies acceptance gate, and selects the winning shape for promotion.

nodes.name: runSelection
nodes.summary: Runs the full selection pass over evaluated candidates, scoring each against the incumbent via acceptance criteria and returning the selected winner.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines all shared TypeScript types and interfaces for the GEPA faza-1 benchmark: corpus instances, candidates, fitness records, evaluation results, and acceptance outcomes.

nodes.name: acceptance.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the GEPA faza-1 acceptance module, covering threshold checks and edge cases for candidate evaluation.

nodes.name: corpus.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the GEPA corpus module, validating instance construction, stratification cells, and spot-audit utilities.

nodes.name: fitness.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Vitest unit tests for the GEPA fitness scoring functions, covering all scoring tiers, bonuses, penalties, and statistical verdict calculations.

nodes.name: mutation-oracle-fork.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the mutation-oracle-fork utilities, validating shape classification, template resolution, and oracle prompt construction.

nodes.name: selection.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the GEPA selection algorithm, covering candidate ranking, acceptance gate behavior, and promotion logic.

nodes.name: cost-probe.ts
nodes.summary: Cost probing script for GEPA phase-5 evolved shapes, measuring token usage and latency distributions across Claude and Qwen evolved shape variants via LiteLLM.

nodes.name: callViaLitellm
nodes.summary: Makes a single LLM inference call via the LiteLLM proxy, recording token counts, cost, and latency.

nodes.name: probe
nodes.summary: Runs a series of LLM inference probes for a given prompt shape, collecting latency and cost samples for statistical analysis.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point: probes all registered evolved shapes, aggregates statistics, and prints a comparison report with percentile breakdowns.

nodes.name: behavioral-spec.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the canonical BEHAVIORAL_SPEC rules for the Waggle agent, organized into named sections with CRITICAL markers, and exports the active spec builder used by the system prompt loader.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports BEHAVIORAL_SPEC (static rules string), COMPACTION_PROMPT (static string), and buildActiveBehavioralSpec (function) — a deliberate split between static content and runtime assembly.

nodes.name: buildActiveBehavioralSpec
nodes.summary: Assembles the active behavioral spec string by merging base BEHAVIORAL_SPEC with any runtime overrides, enabling per-session customization without mutating the static spec.

nodes.name: phase-5-router.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the GEPA Phase-5 canary routing logic that deterministically assigns agent requests to evolved prompt-shape variants based on a hashed bucket percentage.

nodes.name: routeRequestToVariant
nodes.summary: Routes an incoming agent request to either the canary variant or the base shape based on the request's hash bucket and the configured canary percentage.

nodes.name: context-compressor.ts
nodes.summary: Provides conversation context compression utilities for the agent: token estimation, tool-result pruning, middle-section summarization, and a main compressConversation pipeline.

nodes.name: compressConversation
nodes.summary: Main pipeline: determines whether compression is needed, then prunes tool results and/or summarizes the middle portion of the conversation to fit within token budget.

nodes.name: summarizeMiddle
nodes.summary: Calls the LLM to summarize the middle (non-protected) segment of the conversation, replacing it with a compact summary message.

nodes.name: feature-flags.ts
nodes.summary: Defines and exports runtime feature flags for the agent package, including GEPA Phase-5 canary percentage parsing and per-flag enable/disable checks.

nodes.name: parsePhase5CanaryPct
nodes.summary: Parses the GEPA_PHASE5_CANARY_PCT environment variable, clamping the value to [0,100] with a safe default.

nodes.name: checkpoint.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the CheckpointStore class for persistent agent task checkpointing — saves and loads task state to/from disk between agent loop iterations for resumability.

nodes.name: CheckpointStore
nodes.summary: Manages the lifecycle of a long-task checkpoint directory, supporting save, load, integrity verification, and cleanup of step-based state snapshots.

nodes.name: context-manager.ts
nodes.summary: Implements ContextManager for long-running agent tasks, integrating context compression, retrieval-cache eviction, and decision-history summarization to maintain a healthy token budget across iterations.

nodes.name: ContextManager
nodes.summary: Orchestrates token-budget management for long agent tasks: compresses messages, evicts stale retrieval cache, and summarizes decision history when approaching context limits.

nodes.name: failure-classify.ts
nodes.summary: Implements a rule-cascade + LLM-judge failure classification system for agent task responses, categorizing failures into structured types (format violation, wrong entity, metadata copy, etc.) for benchmark analysis.

nodes.name: classifyFailure
nodes.summary: Top-level failure classifier: runs the rule cascade first, falls back to LLM judge when rules are inconclusive, and returns a typed FailureClassification.

nodes.name: classifyFailureBatch
nodes.summary: Classifies a batch of agent responses in parallel, returning an array of FailureClassification objects.

nodes.name: messages-compressor.ts
nodes.summary: Provides LLM-backed message array compression for long-task agent loops: estimates token count, splits into protected/compressible regions, and summarizes the middle via LLM call.

nodes.name: maybeCompressMessages
nodes.summary: Conditionally compresses the message array when token usage exceeds the threshold, replacing the middle segment with an LLM-generated summary.

nodes.name: recovery.ts
nodes.summary: Implements RecoveryRunner for long-task agent execution: wraps the agent loop with checkpoint-based retry, exponential backoff, and structured error/success state building.

nodes.name: RecoveryRunner
nodes.summary: Orchestrates long-task recovery by resolving starting checkpoints, executing the agent loop with retries, and persisting success/error state on completion.

nodes.name: report.ts
nodes.summary: Generates structured evaluation reports for long-task agent runs: computes cell metrics, builds cross-model accuracy matrices, identifies regressions, and renders markdown summaries.

nodes.name: generateReport
nodes.summary: Orchestrates full report generation from pilot records: computes all metrics, builds the matrix, identifies best models and regressions, and assembles a ReportOutput.

nodes.name: renderSummaryMd
nodes.summary: Renders a markdown summary report from computed metrics, including pass rates, confidence intervals, failure distributions, and regression notes.

nodes.name: output-normalize.ts
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw LLM output text for benchmark evaluation by applying configurable transformation passes: stripping think tags, answer labels, markdown fences, copied metadata, and collapsing blank lines.

nodes.name: normalize
nodes.summary: Applies a sequence of configured normalization passes to LLM output text, returning the cleaned string for downstream evaluation.

nodes.name: claude.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the default Claude-targeted prompt shape, embedding the MULTI_STEP_ACTION_CONTRACT and registering it with the shape registry on module load.

nodes.name: generic-simple.ts
nodes.summary: Defines a generic, model-agnostic simple prompt shape without chain-of-thought scaffolding, registering it with the shape registry for use in non-Claude model contexts.
